card.name: Gilasaurus
card.officialText: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand). If Summoned this way: Activate this effect; your opponent can Special Summon 1 monster from their GY.

design.scope: Isolated TagDuel adapter/test/evidence/workflow; no central resolver or catalog registration.
design.selfSummon: Only the Gilasaurus self-Special Summon procedure from the active physical representative's hand during an open Main Phase; Normal Summon and other-effect Special Summon events are rejected. It does not consume the Normal Summon.
design.opponentChoice: The opponent may decline or choose one eligible monster from the opponent team's shared Graveyard at resolution time; the choice is not bound as a target at activation.
design.eligibility: Only actual monsters in the opposing team's Graveyard; tokens and non-monsters are excluded. Fusion/Ritual monsters require properlySummoned=true.
design.ownership: The revived monster is controlled by the opponent team but its physical owner seat is derived from the UID and retained, including an inactive partner's card.
design.trigger: A durable pending activation record is stored in JSON. The trigger resolves even if Gilasaurus leaves the field or changes controller after activation.
design.replay: activationId is unique, persisted while pending, and moved to a resolved receipt on decline, negation, no-legal-monster or successful revival.
design.capacity: Three shared Monster Zones and three Spell/Trap Zones per team; Field Zone is separate; Extra Deck remains at five. A full opposing Monster Zone produces no legal revival.
design.hand: No hand-limit truncation or discard is performed; any over-six hand remains for the End Phase.
design.deck: Deck arrays are not read or modified by this effect. The 20–30 rule remains a deck-construction constraint, not a minimum for an in-progress duel.

certification.reason: Adapter-only preparation. Gilasaurus is absent from cardMetadata, cardCatalog, monsterEffects and cardCertifications on the shared HEAD. No M61 handoff was granted; resolver/catalog/manifest/allowlist were not changed.

limitations: Adapter is not registered in the central monster-effect resolver; Gilasaurus remains unavailable for normal deck admission and uncertified.
The 24 focused tests use offline TagDuel fixtures and injected card metadata; no live Discord gateway or guild was used.
Special Summon restrictions beyond the available metadata's monster kind/type and Fusion/Ritual proper-summon marker are not inferred by this isolated adapter.
Full engine chain ordering and Discord component integration require the protected M61 resolver handoff.
